{{Quote|Keeps them bugs away... It's a good stink.|[[Hefrar Birhan|Birhan]]|<ref name="HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
'''Merlies''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures, [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. Once described as "distressingly intelligent animals", merlie herds were often kept by the local [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] for their [[Milk/Legends|milk]], wool, and meat. Standing nearly a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] high at the shoulder, they were covered in long brown ringlets of wool and had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that were once noted as being "disturbingly [[Human/Legends|Human]]". Merlies were often allowed into the houses of their owners, particularly during winter where they provided additional body warmth, but primarily to protect them from predation by [[gdan]]s. Their pungent odor also repelled insects. They made an "intermittent gargling noise".<ref name="HC" />
